picks.why: Revenue is up 84% with a 12% operating margin at 20x forward earnings, still 49% below its 52-week high despite a 31% five-day rally on data-centre cooling orders. It is the only shortlist name in an overweight segment, and the watchlist covers cooling with Vertiv alone.
picks.risk: Free cash flow is negative (-2% yield) while it builds capacity, and only 4 analysts cover it, so one weak order quarter could undo the rally.
